Here is a list of 100 distinct statements a depressed and anxious client may say to their therapist during a therapy session:

1. "I just feel so overwhelmed all the time. It's like I'm drowning in my own thoughts and emotions."
2. "I used to be so passionate about my work, but now it's like I can barely muster the energy to get out of bed in the morning."
4. "My anxiety has been spiraling out of control lately. The simplest tasks feel like insurmountable challenges."
5. "I can't stop thinking about all the mistakes I've made in my life. It's like a constant chorus of self-criticism in my head."
6. "I used to have such a vibrant social life, but now I find myself avoiding my friends and family because I just don't have the capacity to engage with them."
7. "I feel so guilty for feeling this way, especially when I know there are people out there who have it so much worse than me."
8. "My sleep has been all over the place. Some nights I can't seem to fall asleep at all, and other nights I sleep for 12 hours straight."
9. "I just don't feel like myself anymore. It's like I've lost touch with the person I used to be, and I'm not sure how to get her back."
10. "The weight of my depression and anxiety is just crushing me. I feel like I'm carrying around a heavy load on my shoulders all the time."
11. "I try to put on a brave face for the world, but inside, I'm screaming. I'm just so tired of pretending to be okay."
12. "My appetite has been all over the place. Some days I can barely stomach a single bite, and other days I find myself binge-eating just to try to numb the pain."
13. "I feel like I'm constantly on the verge of a panic attack. The slightest thing can send me into a spiral of fear and worry."
14. "I used to be so confident and self-assured, but now I question every decision I make and every word that comes out of my mouth."
15. "I just want to feel normal again. I miss the days when I didn't have to fight so hard just to get through a single day."
16. "My family and friends keep telling me to 'just snap out of it' or 'just be positive,' but they have no idea how impossible that feels right now."
17. "I find myself constantly second-guessing myself and my abilities. I'm terrified of failure, and it's holding me back from even trying."
18. "I used to be so passionate about my hobbies and interests, but now they just feel like another chore I have to force myself to do."
19. "I feel like I'm living in a constant state of dread, just waiting for the other shoe to drop. It's exhausting."
20. "I've tried so many different treatments and therapies, but nothing seems to be working. I'm starting to lose hope that I'll ever feel better."
21. "The guilt I feel for not being able to be the partner/parent/friend I want to be is overwhelming. I feel like I'm letting everyone down."
22. "I find myself constantly comparing myself to others and feeling like I'm falling short in every aspect of my life."
23. "My mind is always racing, jumping from one anxious thought to the next. It's like I can't ever just catch a break."
24. "I used to be so carefree and spontaneous, but now I find myself overthinking every decision and constantly playing out worst-case scenarios in my head."
25. "I feel like I'm living in a constant state of 'what if.' What if I lose my job? What if my partner leaves me? What if something terrible happens to my loved ones?"
26. "I've tried so many different coping mechanisms, but nothing seems to stick. I just feel like I'm treading water, trying not to drown."
27. "The idea of socializing or even just leaving the house fills me with dread. I've become a hermit, and I hate it."
28. "I used to be so passionate about my career, but now it feels like a chore. I just don't have the same drive or enthusiasm anymore."
29. "I'm constantly worrying about the future and how I'm going to handle everything that's coming my way. It's exhausting."
30. "I feel like I'm stuck in a vicious cycle of negative thoughts and self-doubt. I can't seem to break out of it no matter how hard I try."
31. "My relationships with my loved ones have suffered because of my depression and anxiety. I feel like I'm pushing them away, and I hate it."
32. "I used to be so organized and on top of things, but now, I can barely keep my head above water. Everything feels like a mess."
33. "I'm so tired of feeling like I'm not good enough. It's a constant battle to try to silence that voice in my head."
34. "I find myself constantly procrastinating and avoiding things I know I need to do. It's like I'm stuck in a state of paralysis."
35. "The idea of trying something new or stepping out of my comfort zone fills me with so much fear and anxiety. I feel trapped."
36. "I used to love going on adventures and trying new things, but now, the thought of it just makes me want to curl up in a ball and hide."
37. "I feel like I'm constantly apologizing for my feelings and my needs. I hate feeling like a burden to the people I love."
38. "I used to be so confident and self-assured, but now, I second-guess every decision I make and every word that comes out of my mouth."
39. "I'm so tired of feeling like I'm not living up to the expectations of my family, friends, and even myself. The pressure is crushing me."
40. "I used to be so passionate about my hobbies and interests, but now, they just feel like another chore I have to force myself to do."
41. "The idea of going to work and interacting with people fills me with so much dread. I feel like I'm constantly on the verge of a panic attack."
42. "I'm so tired of feeling like I'm always walking on eggshells, trying not to upset or disappoint the people in my life."
43. "I used to be so carefree and spontaneous, but now, I find myself constantly overthinking every decision and playing out worst-case scenarios in my head."
44. "The guilt I feel for not being able to be the partner/parent/friend I want to be is overwhelming. I feel like I'm letting everyone down."
45. "I find myself constantly comparing myself to others and feeling like I'm falling short in every aspect of my life."
46. "I used to be so social and outgoing, but now, the idea of socializing or even leaving the house fills me with dread."
47. "I'm so tired of feeling like I'm just going through the motions, day in and day out. I miss feeling alive and passionate about life."
48. "The anxiety I feel about the future is paralyzing. I'm constantly worrying about what's going to happen next and how I'm going to handle it."
49. "I used to be so organized and on top of things, but now, everything feels like a mess. I can barely keep my head above water."
50. "I'm so tired of feeling like I'm not good enough. It's a constant battle to try to silence that voice in my head telling me I'm a failure."
